title: I Built a Roblox Mecha Combat Game—Looking for Feedback!
author: pupfboy

comments.author: JirayaaaBoyy106
comments.body: looks great  💯...tell me how much robox you can earn till now

replies.author: pupfboy
replies.body: Haven't made gamepasses or anything yet just being updating the main game and polishing until its ready but I have what type of monetization I want in mind.

replies.author: JirayaaaBoyy106
replies.body: game passes, parts upgrades, buy new mech, weapons system etc you can add to maximize earning

replies.author: pupfboy
replies.body: I don't wanna lock any mechs behind a paypall with having so few but definitely parts upgades and weapon system I plan on working on

replies.author: JirayaaaBoyy106
replies.body: yeah that will be great ..great work man keep it up ♥️

comments.author: OneDay_OneLife
comments.body: Looks cool but would have been better if it was made outside of Roblox, wouldn't touch the platform with a barge pole.

replies.author: pupfboy
replies.body: Roblox is a easier platform to launch games and get players actually playing it compared to something like steam or some website

replies.author: OneDay_OneLife
replies.body: A disturbing platform that fails to protect children, with a ton of games just cash grabbing from kids.

replies.author: pupfboy
replies.body: Yea that part is true, especially the cash grab part but this is more a passion project since Im a big mecha fan.

replies.author: 0DayMaker
replies.body: You're posting this on a platform which shares that exact description..
